symbols.name: AuditRecordEntity
symbols.summary: Owns one immutable logical header and provider lifecycle/publication metadata.

symbols.name: RootJson
symbols.summary: Lossless original root fragment, excluding owned child arrays and hash/envelope.

symbols.name: IntegrityJson
symbols.summary: Optional original integrity envelope, committed with the complete graph.

symbols.name: SearchJson
symbols.summary: Explicit normalized search projection, outside the authenticated document.

symbols.name: Position
symbols.summary: Committed publication order allocated under the store gate.

symbols.name: StorageState
symbols.summary: Provider lifecycle membership, separate from immutable facts.

symbols.name: ArchivedUtcTicks
symbols.summary: UTC archive transition time outside protected facts.

symbols.name: StartedUtcTicks
symbols.summary: Searchable copy of root start UTC ticks.

symbols.name: CompletedUtcTicks
symbols.summary: Searchable copy of finalized UTC ticks and retention anchor.

symbols.name: ActorJson
symbols.summary: Frozen actor snapshot for payload-free summary projections.

symbols.name: InitiatingActorJson
symbols.summary: Optional frozen initiating actor summary snapshot.

symbols.name: SearchProjectionHash
symbols.summary: Digest computed from the actual database projection stream during a bounded read, never a stored trust anchor.
